stocks.label: Ledger
stocks.subject: Mumma: Lydia's houses can be renamed. Asked: "for lydia papa wants to be able to edit the house name". A house's card has Change name above Delete: the box opens with the name, Save renames the house and every Received line naming it (lines keep a house by its name, so its totals follow), another house's name is refused, Undo puts the old name back on all of them; the sheet's Lydia and Lydia houses tabs get the new name. Drive passes; 4 mutants red: lines not following, no refusal, Undo leaving lines, Save adding a house

papa.label: Papa's book
papa.subject: Offline sync: the review's fixes. Appends to one tab take turns inside a process (a save and the outbox sending a kept one at once had picked the same row, the second over the first); a write counts once Google answers 2xx even if reading the answer fails; papa's reads run one after another (an older read had landed on a newer one); every uncertain failure says "It may have saved: check" and the page reads again (no answer from the app's own server, an unreadable answer, wrote: true); no Delete on a save that is sending; a kept bill/line that lands without its photo or second write says so; Stocks puts no-internet on Main/Holdings/Received reads on the line too. Test: two appends at once land on two rows in every app (mutant red); e2e and every suite as before.

planner.label: Planner
planner.subject: planner: the month swipe is faster. The weeks follow the finger, a 40px drag or a quick short flick is enough, and the new month comes in right beside the old one going out, both moved in 110-220 ms by the flick's speed (it used to sit still until the finger left, then fade in over 220 ms); a short slow drag goes back. The weeks are touch-action pan-y so Chrome leaves the sideways drag to the page. ‹ › slide in 160 ms. month-scroll + page e2e pass; mutants red: no follow, no flick, no outgoing month, slow
